Kotlin Multiplatform native D-Bus repository. Layout: `src/commonMain/kotlin` shared API/serialization; `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop` Linux implementation/C interop; `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}` tests/fixtures; `codegen/` JVM XML-to-Kotlin CLI/library; `plugin/` Gradle plugin `com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin`; `compile_test/` integration; `samples/bluez-scan/` consumer.

Use the Gradle wrapper from repo root:
`./gradlew build`
`./gradlew test`
`./gradlew ktlintCheck`
`./gradlew licenseCheck`
`./gradlew dokkaHtml`
`./gradlew codegen:fatJar`
CI release/docs: `gradle publish codegen:fatJar`, `gradle dokkaHtml` on Ubuntu.

Follow `.editorconfig`: 4-space indentation, LF, max line length 100. Kotlin `ktlint` uses `android_studio`. Naming: `UpperCamelCase` classes, `lowerCamelCase` functions/properties, packages under `com.monkopedia.sdbus`. Keep public API changes intentional; use `apiValidation`. Tests: `src/nativeTest`, `codegen/src/test/kotlin`, `plugin`. Prefer behavioral names (e.g. `createsProxyFromXml`). Run `./gradlew test` before PRs; include integration coverage for transport/interop.
